What is libretro-vice-x64dtv-git?

This VICE-libretro core emulates the Commodore 64 Direct-to-TV (C64DTV), the single-chip, joystick-shaped mini-console Commodore released with games built in. It's part of the same RetroArch port of VICE as the other Commodore cores, offering save states, ZIP/M3U support, and remappable controls. It has no interface of its own — RetroArch is the front end.

Install libretro-vice-x64dtv-git on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-x64dtv-git

Good to know

  • C64DTV-compatible software/images to run (not included)
  • RetroArch installed to load the core
